steps: Shortlist the university and note its region / DSU agency (DiSCo, ERSU, ADISU, Edisu, ARDSU, ESU, Opera Universitaria, provincial office, or university-run DSU).
Track the annual bando on the official agency site (usually published June–September for the academic year starting in autumn).
Prepare economic documents early: Italian ISEE Università if the household is in Italy; otherwise ISEE Parificato / ISEEUP via a CAF convenzionato with that agency or university.
Submit the online application within the peremptory deadline (often before final enrollment is complete—check each bando).
Complete Universitaly pre-enrollment (non-EU) and university enrollment, then upload residence permit / ricevuta and IBAN when required to avoid suspension of payments.
Monitor provisional and definitive rankings; meet merit (CFU) deadlines to keep the second installment.
nationalNotes: Regional right-to-study benefits (D.Lgs. 68/2012) are means- and merit-tested. MUR sets national ISEE/ISPE ceilings and minimum scholarship amounts each year; regions may set lower ceilings.

ISEE Parificato (also called ISEEUP / ISEEU Parificato) is required when the student’s family income/assets are abroad or when a standard INPS ISEE Università cannot be issued (typical for Pakistani and other non-EU students whose household is outside Italy).

Foreign income/asset certificates must usually be issued by competent authorities in the country of origin, translated into Italian, and legalized (Apostille or Italian Embassy/Consulate). Pakistan: legalization via Italian Embassy/Consulate routes applies.

Universitaly pre-enrollment is separate from DSU: non-EU students need an admission offer, Universitaly pre-enrollment, and a study visa; DSU applications often allow applying before enrollment is finalized, with a later enrollment deadline in the bando.
Winning or being idoneo (eligible) for a regional scholarship usually brings exemption/refund of the regional DSU tax and often university tuition reduction or waiver—confirm in each bando.
Typical benefits package: cash stipend (higher for fuori sede), canteen/meals, housing or housing contribution, sometimes international mobility top-up and graduation prize.
MAECI / Invest Your Talent and other national/university merit scholarships are separate from regional DSU; check cumulation rules in each call.
2027/2028 bandi are generally not yet published as of 2026-09-08; expect similar calendars (approx. Jun–Sep openings) unless a region announces otherwise.
